name: @sugarcommerce/storage-browser
description: The bucket browser's and picker's scripts, built to build/ with @wordpress/scripts.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build browser=./src/js/browser.js picker=./src/js/picker.js connection=./src/js/connection.js host=./src/js/host.js edd=./src/js/edd.js wc=./src/js/wc.js --output-path=assets/build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start browser=./src/js/browser.js picker=./src/js/picker.js connection=./src/js/connection.js host=./src/js/host.js edd=./src/js/edd.js wc=./src/js/wc.js --output-path=assets/build
